openClinicalQuestions: Which India-specific vaccination panel (beyond rubella/MMR discussion) should Dr. Charmi routinely list for preconception visits?
Any FOGSI-preferred preconception blood tests she wants named for average-risk couples?

claimLedger.claim: 400 mcg folic acid daily for women of reproductive age in the preconception period up to the first trimester
claimLedger.sourceSection: India National Health Mission · Anaemia Mukt Bharat · not stated on page; also confirmed in Anaemia Mukt Bharat Operational Guidelines PDF
claimLedger.limitations: Indian public-health programme wording; individual medical risks may need a prescribed higher dose decided by a clinician

claimLedger.claim: 400 μg folic acid daily from trying to conceive until 12 weeks; 5 mg offered after a previous NTD-affected pregnancy
claimLedger.sourceSection: WHO · Periconceptional folic acid supplementation to prevent neural tube defects (eLENA) · last updated 9 Aug 2023 (parent-verified; live fetch timed out this session — wording matched WHO eLENA search extract)
claimLedger.limitations: Global recommendation; higher-dose criteria beyond prior NTD pregnancy are jurisdiction-specific

claimLedger.claim: MMR before pregnancy if needed; stop smoking; no alcohol; do not stop prescribed medicines until talking to GP/specialist; speak to GP with epilepsy, diabetes, sickle cell, HIV or fertility concerns
claimLedger.sourceSection: NHS · Trying to get pregnant · page live at fetch; review date not shown in extract
claimLedger.limitations: UK pathway; Indian vaccine schedules and referral routes may differ
